findings.value: A modern pub on Brick Lane in the old Truman Brewery buildings, serving local beers, with live music and DJs at weekends.

evidence.quote: Set within the Old Brewmaster's House of the Truman Brewery, Ninety One is your local on Brick Lane - a modern pub in a historic location.
Our drinks list is rooted in local beers
evening jazz/blues & craft beer incl. Beavertown
Think disco and funk to afro beat, jazz,

findings.value: Live music and DJs at weekends, with a weekly Friday night of live performers and a DJ, according to the venue and DesignMyNight.

evidence.quote: Come the weekend, live music and DJs take over, bringing house party energy and late-night dancing long after dark.
Every Friday, we invite live performances to the stage with a DJ
Ninety One Living Room, London - Jazz & Craft Beer

notes: Its own site (91bricklane.pub, linked from the DesignMyNight organiser entry) and CAMRA WhatPub were read; the DesignMyNight Friday series is one dated event page (11 Sep 2026) that says it is a weekly night. The CAMRA and own-site pages carry no visible date, so their music styles are undated. No review or press article found in one WebSearch. No status news.
